text: Trace result: a narrow LinearEngine wrapper would preserve completed prior levels and optimizer-local counters, but it would still undercount a partially failed rigid/affine objective because current evaluator errors do not carry their interpolation/patch counters. Correct implementation must introduce an evidence-bearing evaluator/optimizer failure result, snapshot best and last-valid state after the initial checkpoint, aggregate prior levels, and preserve partial data-work counters at the adapter boundary. Do not synthesize zero counters or reuse the selection objective as a missing optimization objective.
